acceptance_criteria.criterion: WorkspaceOrchestrator.createWorkspace() writes a Source: 'credentials', Severity: 'info', Operation: 'workspace-setup' log entry after successful clone when credential !== null.
RepositoryOrchestrator.addRepositoryToProject() writes a Source: 'credentials', Severity: 'info', Operation: 'add-repository' log entry after successful clone when credential !== null.
SSH clones where credential === null do NOT produce an 'info' log entry in either orchestrator.
checkWorkspaceHealth() does NOT report a credential-missing health issue when the most recent Source: 'credentials' entry for the repository has Severity: 'info'.
checkWorkspaceHealth() still reports a credential-missing health issue when the most recent entry is Severity: 'error', even if an older Severity: 'info' entry exists.
The @remarks JSDoc on checkWorkspaceHealth() reflects the stale badge resolution mechanism.
All new tests pass and all existing tests continue to pass.

summary:
All implementation for WP-007 was already in place across the three source files and their corresponding test files. Verified against all acceptance criteria:

1. WorkspaceOrchestrator.createWorkspace() writes Source:'credentials', Severity:'info', Operation:'workspace-setup' after successful credential-based clone when credential !== null — implemented at lines 199–209 of workspace-orchestrator.ts.
2. RepositoryOrchestrator.addRepositoryToProject() writes Source:'credentials', Severity:'info', Operation:'add-repository' after successful credential-based clone when credential !== null — implemented at lines 188–198 of repository-orchestrator.ts.
3. SSH clones (credential === null) do NOT produce an info log entry in either orchestrator — guarded by the `if (credential !== null)` condition.
4. checkWorkspaceHealth() suppresses credential-missing when the most recent Source:'credentials' entry has Severity:'info' — implemented via Set-based de-duplication in workspace-health.ts (lines 116–133).
5. checkWorkspaceHealth() re-surfaces credential-missing when the most recent entry is Severity:'error' even if an older info entry exists — same de-duplication logic naturally handles this.
6. @remarks JSDoc on checkWorkspaceHealth() already reflects the stale badge resolution mechanism.
7. All 933 tests pass (0 failures), including the new credential success log and stale badge suppression tests in workspace-orchestrator.test.ts, repository-orchestrator.test.ts, and workspace-health.test.ts."

Add a brief comment near setupFakeGit() in test-helpers.ts explaining that tests requiring a successful clone (i.e. those that need a .git directory to pass the success gate) must use an inline script or an extended variant — the shared helper is intentionally minimal and does not produce a .git directory.

workspace-health.ts: The Set-based newest-first deduplication in Check 3 (lines 116–133) is correct and elegant. The approach of trusting the sort-order contract from errorLogManager.list() (newest-first) is sound, but it is a subtle implicit coupling. A single inline assertion or comment referencing the contract (e.g. '// list() returns newest-first; see ErrorLogManager.list()') would make the coupling explicit for future maintainers — no change required, just noting as low-priority awareness.
